findings.scene: raw simulate_pace_conditioned mainline.pace contains provisional most-frequent or caller-fixed pace. Passing that string directly to select_pace_candidates yields eligible_candidates without checking fixing_status or statistical_confirmation.
findings.evidence: Adapter sets selected_pace=None absent statistical_confirmation, but selector accepts arbitrary pace string and returns status EVALUATED with no confirmation/hypothesis qualifier.
findings.fix: Mark direct selector results explicitly as unconfirmed hypothesis comparisons, or add an evidence-aware confirmed-selection wrapper that enforces confirmation and confirmed pace identity. Keep manual requested scenarios hypothetical. Add raw-provisional-to-selector regression coverage. Do not add a production refusal threshold from this research rule.
findings.resolution: Raw conditional mainline.pace/summary now None; suggested/requested scenarios live in hypothesis fields only. Lower selector emits statistical_confirmation=false,hypothesis_only=true. Confirmed selector recomputes every look using fixed schedule/counts/alpha/min_gap and validates stopping, final frequency, confirmed/requested pace and flags before transferring mainline.

findings.reason: A bootstrap may precisely identify the most frequent pace in a biased or tiny empirical draw pool. 100->1000 confirmation and near-tie100->10000 exhaustion are synthetic behavior checks, not actual-race evidence.
findings.fix: Retain incomplete status for actual data-driven pace learning and date-separated calibration. Distinguish additional MC samples from additional independent race/training observations.
